features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio marking shear layers where SST equilibrium assumption fails.

features.name: f_apg

features.name: f_wdist

proposal.risk_audit: All three checked dimensionless under velocity*2/length*3 scaling; denominators are k>0, omega>0, Max(Umag,sqrt(k))>0 so finite at wall and in freestream (no d, Snorm, Umag division); signed curv/pgwork preserve separation vs attached ordering after x/(|x|+median) mapping; complement I1/I2/f_noneq (curvature sign, APG work per turnover, Lagrangian acceleration) rather than duplicate; main risk is pgwork correlating with f_noneq in shear, mitigated by dropping unused f_apg and retaining f_wdist (terms_using=1, gain -0.0005 within noise) for wall information.

features.name: f_curv

features.name: f_pgwork

features.name: f_accel

features: UgradP / (omega * (Umag + sqrt(k) + omega * d) * (Umag + sqrt(k) + omega * d))

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 are dimensionless (L/T velocity scales cancel, 1/T rates cancel); denominators are strictly >0 given omega>0 and d>0 at cell centers (no bare constants, no dimensional adds), so finite on ~100% and bounded or regularized to avoid wall/freestream blow-up; orderings differ from f_noneq/f_accel (APG sign, curvature sign, wall-bounded length) and replace dropped f_wdist/f_curv/f_pgwork which have heldout_gain<=0.

features.name: f_apgs
features.formula: UgradP / (omega * (Umag + sqrt(k) + omega * d) * (Umag + sqrt(k) + omega * d))
features.rationale: Wall-safe APG work per turnover (>0 adverse) to locate separation/reattachment without k->0 singularity.

features.name: f_curvb
features.rationale: Bounded rotation excess over strain to separate curvature-dominated bubbles (+) from attached shear (~0) and stagnation strain (-).

features.name: f_wallb
features.rationale: Bounded turbulent length over wall distance to separate near-wall versus free-shear SST stress error.

features: DUDt_mag / (DUDt_mag + Umag*Snorm + Umag*Wnorm + omega*(Umag + sqrt(k) + omega*d))

proposal.risk_audit: All formulas unit-checked L-T: UgradP/[L2/T3] over Max([L2/T3],[L2/T3]) dimensionless; DUDt/[L/T2] over sum [L/T2] bounded [0,1]; omega*d/[L/T] over sum [L/T] bounded [0,1]. Denominators >0 for cell-center d>0 since omega>0, so finite; no k or Umag-only denominator to avoid wall singularity. Overlap risk: f_pwork complements f_noneq (Pk/eps) by adding pressure-work vs turbulence, not redundant with f_accel; f_bend shares DUDt with f_accel but normalizes by shear/rotation not turbulence so different ordering for curvature; f_wallp replaces f_wallb with monotonic wall-vs-free ordering to avoid non-monotonic l/(l+d) peak. Dropping f_apgs/f_curvb (0 use, 0 gain) safe; dropping f_wallb (in-best but -0.0004 heldout gain) risks small train regression but should improve heldout generalization and is replaced by f_wallp.

features.name: f_pwork
features.rationale: APG pressure work versus turbulence production plus dissipation to mark separation/reattachment where pressure dominates equilibrium.

features.name: f_bend
features.formula: DUDt_mag / (DUDt_mag + Umag*Snorm + Umag*Wnorm + omega*(Umag + sqrt(k) + omega*d))
features.rationale: Bounded mean-flow bending versus shear plus rotation to flag streamline curvature and turning in bubbles where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_wallp
features.rationale: Monotonic wall proximity versus free shear to switch near-wall separation correction from free-shear correction.

features: UgradP * d / ((Umag + sqrt(k) + omega*d)*(k + Umag*Umag + omega*omega*d*d))

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed features checked dimensionless under velocity*2 length*3 scaling: f_apg_d L3/T3 over (L/T)(L2/T2); f_kadv L2/T3 over L2/T3; f_curv L2/T2 over L2/T2. Finite by construction: f_apg_d denominator uses (Umag+sqrtk+omega*d)>0 and (k+Umag^2+omega^2d^2)>0 for d>0; f_kadv reuses accepted omega^3d^2 floor; f_curv denominator contains omega^2d^2>0. No pure S/W/omega ratios to avoid redundancy with I1/I2. Risk: APG and k-advection may correlate with f_noneq/f_accel in shear layers but order differently via signed work and d-weighting; bounded mapping limits outliers. Drop f_pwork/f_bend (gain 0, terms_using 0) to free slots; retain f_wallp despite -0.0005 gain because it anchors T1 wall switch until replacements proven.

features.name: f_apg_d
features.formula: UgradP * d / ((Umag + sqrt(k) + omega*d)*(k + Umag*Umag + omega*omega*d*d))
features.rationale: Signed APG pressure work over wall distance versus local kinetic energy to separate APG separation from FPG acceleration in CD channel and bumps.

proposal.risk_audit: All formulas checked dimensionless (V*2,L*3 invariant), denominators strictly positive via eps/abs or omega wall floors to stay finite; orderings target APG work, curvature turning, and lifted-vs-attached shear distinct from Pk/eps and accel; wall-adjacent 0/0 avoided.

features.name: f_dshear

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L: f_apgdir L2/T3 over L2/T3, f_pforce L/T2 over L/T2, f_transp L2/T3 over L2/T3. Wall 0/0 or Inf limited to wall points <1% so finite>=99% expected; f_pforce uses +gradp_mag to stay finite except wall k=0. Ordering distinct from active f_noneq/f_accel/f_dshear: direction vs magnitude vs transport, not redundant with I1/I2 strain-rotation. Drop f_wallp/f_pgwork/f_turn with heldout_gain 0 to free slots.
